claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament had a total purse of $22.5 million.
The 2026 Masters Tournament purse is the largest in Masters history.
Rory McIlroy was the champion of the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Rory McIlroy won $4.5 million at the 2026 Masters Tournament.
The 2026 Masters purse was a $1.5 million increase over the 2025 purse.
Professional golfers who made the cut at the 2026 Masters Tournament received a share of the $22.5 million purse.
Professional golfers who missed the cut at the 2026 Masters Tournament received $25,000.
Scottie Scheffler finished second place at the 2026 Masters Tournament and earned $2.43 million.
